evaluation: post-formal re-gating of the same eighty saved evaluation histories; no prospective sample, refit, action selection or deployment change
gate: retain complete-fit candidate iff saved full-SSE gap<=threshold; a fit-failure method retains all candidates
k_rule: minimum k in 1..n with scipy.stats.binom.sf(k-1,n,1-alpha)<=delta; otherwise threshold +infinity
score: maximum over the frozen eleven methods of true-candidate full-SSE gap; any required calibration fit failure gives +infinity
subgroup_scope: no star/weak or fixed-theta conditional risk guarantee
